notes.title: New Update 1.09
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26349196/6e73de7161b97b1b675cd1286cb01aebd03af34b.jpg[/img]

New update reveals all map sources for the community.
This is a nice opportunity for modders to learn approaches used in the game's level design. We hope that the update will encourage more people to create and share their cool stuff for Haydee!

Also changed:
[list]
[*]All the Haydee bodies are now the same as the player.
[*]Description field in the Workshop Uploader/Updater is now multiline.
[*]Minor fixes and optimizations.
[/list]
